'Rewilding' To Feature in 'Best American Science & Nature Writing 2025'

New York, US ⬩ 2025-03-25

This came as a huge and delightful surprise: We Need To Rewild The Internet, which I co-authored with the mighty Maria Farrell and that was published in April 2024 by Noema has been selected to feature in the classic anthology Best American Science & Nature Writing 2025.

The book will come out later in 2025. I am incredibly excited to hold a physical copy.
